_comment: Ceiling on PureFIT's own median time, in milliseconds, per fixture and scenario. Absolute rather than measured against the Garmin SDK, so a release of theirs can never move our pass mark. CI runs 2-3x slower than a local M-series Mac and varies enormously run to run: Parse measured 65.9 / 84.5 / 97.7 / 107.6 ms across four runs of identical code, a 63% spread between fastest and slowest. Budgets are ~1.6x the slowest observation. That is a coarse gate by necessity — it catches a gross regression, not a 20% one. Do not tighten toward the median; the spread is the constraint. Two fixtures are gated: cyclingActivityFromGarmin.fit has no developer fields at all, so activity_developerdata.fit is what actually covers developer-field handling.
